correctness.rationale: Directly derived complete (2m-1)-dimensional weighted gradient system for all m≥2; each off-diagonal coefficient is nonnegative when c_ij≥1 and strict connectedness gives a strictly positive propagator. Constant-gradient comparison solves a two-mode ODE; Markov oscillation contraction bounds all added peripheral clique-edge gradients by e^{-mt}, strictly below the bridge. An explicit ramp attains the global bound, and strict bridge-row positivity proves uniqueness up to scalar and constants. Differentiation and algebraic expansion prove one peak and sharp factor-three limit. Separate exact rational intertwining checks on 120 basis vectors and 45 independent weighted heat checks corroborate calculations, but are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A structural rigidity theorem for infinitely many graph sizes and arbitrarily heterogeneous, unbounded-strength interior heat conductances. Although adding all missing clique edges changes graph geometry and the Laplacian, the exact time-dependent norm and all extremizers remain invariant. The full sharp temporal amplification and limiting diameter-three barrier give a meaningful robust family of Markov semigroup benchmarks, not a routine numeric recomputation of one graph.
